title: Vectors and Matrices for ML
description: The basic objects of linear algebra, built from Python lists and NumPy arrays you already know.
learningOutcomes: Explain a vector and matrix as data, not abstract symbols
Compute dot products and matrix multiplication by hand and in NumPy
Connect matrix shapes to real model inputs

lessons.title: Vectors as Data
lessons.description: A vector as a row of a dataset, not a physics arrow.
learningObjectives: Represent a data row as a vector
Compute vector addition and scalar multiplication
Compute vector magnitude and interpret it

lessons.title: The Dot Product
lessons.description: One number that shows up everywhere in ML: similarity and weighted sums.
learningObjectives: Compute a dot product by hand and with NumPy
Connect the dot product to cosine similarity
Connect the dot product to a weighted sum in a model

lessons.title: Matrices as Datasets and Transforms
lessons.description: A matrix as a table of data, and as a function that transforms vectors.
learningObjectives: Represent a dataset as a matrix
Compute matrix multiplication and explain shape rules
Explain a matrix as a linear transformation

lessons.title: Why ML Code Is Full of Matrix Multiplication
lessons.description: Connect matrix math directly to a line of real model code.
learningObjectives: Trace a linear layer's forward pass as matrix multiplication
Read shape errors as matrix-dimension mismatches
Predict output shape from input and weight shapes
